data.content_ref: inline:The target claims the nocturnal UHI gap is larger in arid cities because irrigated urban green spaces create a latent heat oasis effect. This mechanism would require the urban core to be COOLER than the surroundings (an urban oasis, a negative UHI), not WARMER. Introducing evapotranspiration into an arid city absorbs energy as latent heat, which reduces the sensible heat available for nocturnal release, thereby SHRINKING the nocturnal UHI gap, not enlarging it.
